contracts.probability: Ordinary Ascension success1/failure9 =10%/90%; no ordinary lore modifier. contracts.exclusive: Nirvana gets exactly three total Angelic event spins and no ordinary Weapon Mastery+1. Paladin Biasa gets exactly one Angelic event spin and one all-owned Weapon Mastery+1 source. No successful branch inherits the failed-branch reward.
contracts.form: Nirvana High Paladin is one source-owned evolved form attached to the original Paladin result. Preserve original identity/provenance. It is distinct from Royal/Pawn Royal High Paladin and triggers no Royal chess/evolution/all-stat reward, second Archetype/race/Size spin or replacement Title.
contracts.angelic: Reuse only power-angelic; no private wheel, copied definitions or Divine substitution. Each call is an actual independent wheel invocation with unique step ID/ordinal and saved continuation; grant exactly its selected canonical power before reacting. Canonical pool stays unchanged between calls; repeated results do not cause uniqueness rerolls or an invented fallback power.
contracts.ownership: Each actual grant records its own source. Global owned-power duplicate/identity handling remains the existing policy; repeated selections add no guessed tier/mastery/stat bonus. Early owned powers survive normal main Power None and use the one normal common Power Mastery resolution.
contracts.mastery: Only Paladin Biasa registers +1 Weapon Mastery once for all active owned weapon instances, including later grants; no Power Mastery boost, weapon grant, guaranteed Master or early mastery spin. Final calculation uses each retained raw weapon mastery plus source-once modifiers, never a previously adjusted result.
contracts.enchantment: Effective Weapon Mastery after final +1 can qualify at Master5+, subject to active compatible weapon/unused slot. No early Enchant and no Power Enchant. Empty weapon inventory creates no phantom item or mastery draw; the source modifier can bind to a later owned weapon.
contracts.mainFlow: Paladin Angelic children resolve during the Archetype event. Normal main Weapon/Power acquisitions and their ordinary stages remain scheduled; event child count does not consume the later main Power spin.
contracts.tier: Resolve and freeze each selected Angelic canonical definition reference/mode/rating under power-tier/1.0.0. Paladin applies no intrinsic tier floor, tier weight boost or maximum mastery override; the Assassin Tier3/4 brief does not apply to this caller.
contracts.ledger: Freeze chance pool/odds/version/outcome/selected profile, owned form or mastery source and child schedule. Commit branch once at runId/sourceArchetypeInvocationId/sourceAscensionSpinId/eventProfileId; each Angelic child has a distinct invocation source. Replay/media retries resume the existing next ordinal and never repeat chance, completed child, grant, form or bonus.
contracts.reaction: Stack only actual Paladin/Ascension/form/selected Angelic results and pending mastery source with provenance. Later child power/stat/mastery results stay unknown until rolled. Names/captions/fixed form/bonus do not create funny-result tags or extra Shrek hooks.
contracts.return: Finish the selected branch's mandatory children and their events/reactions in sequence; restore Backstory only after the last child. Preserve earlier race rewards and the accepted Archetype gate/global Size/race history.
